items.headline: Scheffler’s Presidents Cup Controversy
items.text: Scottie Scheffler sparked controversy following a sudden decision during Sunday’s Presidents Cup, drawing mixed reactions including tension with reporters and emotional remarks from his wife.

items.headline: U.S. leads 14th Presidents Cup
items.text: The United States secured their 14th Presidents Cup victory in the 16th edition, prompting Brandel Chamblee to call for two major changes to the event.
